pmr_dam_columbia_river_begin_survey = {
	set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_columbia_river_months value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying
	add_modifier = { name = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying }
	add_journal_entry = { type = je_pmr_dam_columbia_river_survey }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_active_surveys } }
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = 1 }
	debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_start|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
}

	set_global_variable = pmr_dam_agno_gorge_surveying
	add_modifier = { name = pmr_dam_agno_gorge_surveying }
	add_journal_entry = { type = je_pmr_dam_agno_gorge_survey }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_active_surveys } }
		set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = pmr_dam_active_surveys add = 1 }
	debug_log = "PMR_DAM|survey_start|agno_gorge|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]"
}

pmr_dam_columbia_river_on_level = {
	if = {
		limit = { level >= 19 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 19/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 18 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 18/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 17 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 17/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 16 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 16/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 15 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 15/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 14 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 14/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 13 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 13/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 12 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 12/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 11 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 11/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 10 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 10/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 9 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 9/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 8 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 8/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 7 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 7/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 6 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 6/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 5 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 5/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 4 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 4/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 3 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 3/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 2 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 2/19" }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { level >= 1 }
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|built|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|level 1/19" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { level >= 19  NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_complete } }
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_complete
		owner ?= { debug_log = "PMR_DAM|complete|columbia_river|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]" }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { level >= 1  NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_fx_1 } }
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_fx_1
		s:STATE_WASHINGTON = {
				add_arable_land = 15
			}
	}
}

		limit = { level >= 1  NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_sennar_blue_nile_fx_1 } }
		set_global_variable = pmr_dam_sennar_blue_nile_fx_1
		s:STATE_BLUE_NILE = {
				remove_state_trait = state_trait_pmr_rainfed_plain
				add_arable_land = 12
			}
	}
}
